user.title: Magewell Pro Convert Decoder
user.description: Uses the Decoder HTTP API (GET /mwapi?method=ping). Hostname or IP address both work for device communication.

data.password: API password (stored encrypted; MD5 sent to device per Magewell login API)

data_description.host: Use the device hostname (e.g. magewell-decoder.local) or its IP address. You can switch later via Reconfigure.

reconfigure.title: Update Magewell Decoder
reconfigure.description: Change hostname/IP, SSL, or login. Leave password blank to keep the current password.

data_description.host: Switch between hostname and IP at any time; both are supported for mwapi requests.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid hostname or IP address (without http://).
error.invalid_port: Port must be between 1 and 65535, or leave blank for 80 / 443.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device or the response was not valid JSON. Check host, port, and SSL settings.
error.auth_required: This decoder requires mwapi login. Enter username and password (see Magewell login API — pass is MD5 of password).
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check username and password (Magewell status 36 = wrong id or password).
error.auth_session_failed: Login succeeded but the device still reports not logged in on the next call. Check hostname/IP and port, then reload the integration.

switch_source.name: Switch source by name
switch_source.description: Select a preset or NDI source using a plain name. Use from dashboard buttons and automations.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: This Magewell Decoder instance (optional if entity_id is set).

entity_id.name: Source entity
entity_id.description: The Source select entity for this decoder (optional if config entry is set).

source.name: Source name
source.description: Preset or NDI name, e.g. Apple TV.

source_type.name: Source type
source_type.description: auto tries preset then NDI; ndi or preset forces the type.

set_ndi_stream.name: Set NDI stream by name
set_ndi_stream.description: Selects an NDI source by exact name, or creates an ntkndi preset if the device requires it.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: This Magewell Decoder integration instance (optional if entity_id is set).

entity_id.name: Source entity
entity_id.description: The Source select entity (optional if config entry is set).

ndi_name.name: NDI stream name
ndi_name.description: Exact NDI name as shown in discovery or on the sender.

ndi_ip_port.name: NDI host:port
ndi_ip_port.description: Optional. Required for ntkndi fallback if set-channel fails and discovery has no match (e.g. 192.168.1.10:5961).

preset_label.name: Preset label
preset_label.description: Channel name used when add-channel is needed (1–120 characters).

set_http_stream.name: Set HTTP stream and select
set_http_stream.description: Adds or updates a URL preset and switches the decoder to it.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: This Magewell Decoder integration instance (optional if entity_id is set).

entity_id.name: Source entity
entity_id.description: The Source select entity (optional if config entry is set).

channel_name.name: Preset name
channel_name.description: Label in the decoder source list (1–120 characters).

update_if_exists.name: Update if exists
update_if_exists.description: If the preset name already exists, modify its URL instead of failing.
